variants.headline: Still in view: cyclone hits the colony
variants.sub: The colony has been struck by a cyclone.
variants.body:
A cyclone has hit the colony. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The gazette records the cyclone while withholding particulars of consequences not supplied to this notice. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Still in view: a storm becomes the colony's news
variants.body:
The colony has been struck by a cyclone. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

variants.headline: Still in view: the colony faces a cyclone
variants.sub: A cyclone has hit the colony.
variants.body:
A cyclone has reached {colony}. Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point.

The gazette records the cyclone while withholding particulars of consequences not supplied to this notice. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
